verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a first-party AI Assistant built into the Dashboard that claims to automate repetitive tasks and give context-aware support, so a built-in assistant exists. The evidence is only two short marketing lines, so the depth of what users can actually delegate is unproven. The MCP server, plugins and agent skills serve external agents, not a built-in assistant, and are not credited here. missing for 10: in-depth docs on which tasks the assistant can execute end-to-end (e.g., writing or running SQL, creating policies, managing migrations), approval and action controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated task execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Supabase AI Assistant is integrated into the Supabase Dashboard to drastically improve your database management experience.
The AI Assistant can save you hours of work by automating repetitive tasks and providing context-aware support.
